$comment: Classified inventory of every upstream-Jellyfin host reference this repository still carries.
Enforced by scripts/verify-no-runtime-jellyfin.mjs; explained in docs/tesserafin/b1-jellyfin-boundary.md.
A (file, host) pair that is not listed here fails the gate until a human classifies it.
Permitted classes: inherited-identity, attribution, developer-sync, inert-link, inherited-trust-allowlist, test-fixture.
The classes #54 forbids — runtime-network and active-automation — cannot be written here: the gate rejects them on sight.
`built: true` additionally declares that the host is EXPECTED to survive into dist/.

entries.why: Links the Jellyfin Code of Conduct in the bug-report checklist. Inherited prose shown to a human filing an issue; nothing fetches it. Rewriting the issue templates in Tesserafin's own voice is presentation work and belongs to B2/E1, not B1.
Same Code of Conduct link in the playback-issue checklist. See above.
Points contributors at the upstream contributing guide. Prose in a template, read by humans on github.com; no automation resolves it.

Thirteen documentation URLs rendered as `href` targets on dashboard help buttons. The application never fetches them; a user may click one and leave. Replacing them needs Tesserafin documentation to exist first (E1).
Three `href` links to upstream hardware-acceleration and font documentation on the transcoding settings page.

TRUSTED_REPO_URL. The web client never contacts this host — the SERVER fetches plugin repositories. The constant only decides whether the install confirmation dialog is skipped, so an inherited upstream origin is implicitly trusted. Not a class 5 runtime dependency (no request is made from the browser), but it is a real inherited trust decision and is recorded as such in docs/tesserafin/b1-jellyfin-boundary.md for a follow-up outside B1.
`href` to the upstream translation-contribution page in the general settings screen.
`href` on the setup wizard's library help button.

Four per-collection-type documentation URLs handed to the wizard's help button as its `href`. Onboarding completes without any of them being resolved — proven by the onboarding browser gate and by tests/e2e/no-runtime-jellyfin.spec.ts.
`href` on the first setup-wizard screen's help link.
An `href` inside the ServerUpdateNeeded message only. The Unavailable state that B1's network-failure criterion exercises renders MessageUnableToConnectToServer and contains no upstream link at all.
An arbitrary absolute image URL used as a unit-test input string. Never requested: the assertion is on the URL the builder produces.
`href` on the subtitle editor's external-files help button.
